response: Shnoor (shnoor.com) offers comprehensive IT solutions including Cloud, Enterprise, AI, Staffing, Verification, Network, and Healthcare.

hrm.shnoor.com is our Next Generation HR Management application built for small to large businesses. It offers No Hidden Fees, Multiple Language Support, Employee & Staff Management, powerful Payroll processing, and detailed tracking for attendance, leaves, and expenses.

Our HRM system features one-click payroll generation, auto-generation based on leaves and attendance, salary group assignments, dynamic letterheads & salary slips, as well as accounting, expenses, and currencies tracking.

Employee management allows you to manage staff by location, assign roles and managers, track leaves, holidays, and attendance. It also handles increments, promotions, and provides a powerful dashboard for the employee view.
Our HRM platform includes comprehensive features like Asset Management, Shifts, Appreciations, Awards, Company Policy, Permissions, Offboarding, Survey Forms, and company News.

lms.shnoor.com is our Enterprise Learning Platform built for smarter workforce training. It provides a modern learning ecosystem with 8 core capabilities, role-based journeys, guided learning, and 99.9% reliable operations.

Our LMS delivers learning formats built for how your teams work: Instructor-led training, Private corporate programs, Practice arenas (self-paced exercises), Facilitated labs (hands-on environments), and comprehensive Exam preparation.

Our platform supports modern workflows: launch role-based journeys (onboarding, compliance, upskilling), deliver guided learning via live instruction & practice labs, and validate mastery through structured cohorts, assignments, and certification paths.

Administrators get a powerful Control Center to manage users, reports, and approvals. Our Learning Delivery Engine organizes modules and session flows, while ensuring outcome-driven progress tracking and industry-facing certifications.

assessments.shnoor.com is our Secure Examination Portal for SHNOOR recruitment drives. It allows candidates to access auto-assigned tests, take secure proctored exams, and track results all in one place.

Taking an assessment is a 3-step process: Register with your institute details, Take the secure proctored exam, and Submit securely. During the exam, you'll see a timer countdown and your answers will auto-save.

The platform offers Auto-Assigned Tests based on your institute, Scheduled Tests with deadlines, Multiple Attempts (for some tests), Auto-Save so you can resume if disconnected, and immediate Submission Receipts.
Our exams use a Secure Examination Environment with Live Proctoring (webcam monitoring), Fullscreen Enforcement, Tab Switch Detection (max 3 warnings), Auto-Submit on timeout, and Encrypted Answers.

Shnoor Invoicing (invoicecloud.in) lets you create, manage, and send professional invoices without the hassle. Automate reminders, track payments, and get a real-time financial overview from one simple platform.

Our Intelligent Dashboard tracks total revenue, pending, and overdue payments. Features include Smart Invoice Creation (generate in under 30 seconds with autofill) and one-click Smart Payment Reminders.
Shnoor Invoicing is built on Simplicity First, Built for Growth, and Customer Obsession. Founded in 2025, our team of 50+ members proudly serves over 1,000 happy clients.
We offer clear value plans: Free (up to 10 invoices/mo), Professional (₹19/mo for unlimited invoices & advanced templates), and Business (₹49/mo with custom templates & 24/7 phone support).
